gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy sets its heavy letters with a poured, uniform thickness through every turn. Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps short ascenders and a tall x-height, so a long stretch of text stays easy on the eye.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-takri: Loud, flat, contrast-free letters from Luckiest Guy sit over a body with a high-waisted lowercase. Bump up Noto Sans Takri a notch if it feels slight.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Luckiest Guy holds a mean, high line with no quill-like tapering anywhere in its poured-looking letters. Noto Sans Tamil is the quiet one, looking magnified while terminals stop far from the stem.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supp: Luckiest Guy bends its lines like a straw, loud and cheerful, with an e that opens plainly to the right. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement gets stocky and tall in the middle band, its rounds like open parentheses.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Round, loud and cheerful: every o in Luckiest Guy is a ring with a constant wall. Give Noto Sans Tangsa a little more size, since its short ascender stems sit on tall bodies.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC opens its curves outward with big counters in a, e and s, which feels welcoming. Luckiest Guy shouts with a smooth drawn-wire line, while the body simply keeps talking.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Cheerful from the first word, Luckiest Guy draws every stroke the same, with no heavier downstrokes. And Noto Sans Telugu, with its high-set midline and counters connected to the outside, takes over for the actual reading.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads, with rounded letters left open. Noto Sans Thai is the friendly part here, while Luckiest Guy turns corners with no pressure swell at all.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Loud and cheerful, with strokes of one width. Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall bodies that look bold, and spacious gaps at its curve terminals keep a long passage moving without strain.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh reads soft and inviting, its lowercase bowls filling the line like inflated shapes. Luckiest Guy is the loud one with a mean high line, while the body hums quietly along.
